full_prompt_en: A square sepia photographic portrait shows a seated woman in a broad fabric bonnet leaning an arm on a rough stone ledge. The background is a softly blurred outdoor arrangement of dark foliage, stone, and a small pale opening high at the right. The woman occupies most of the frame, her body angled toward the right while her face turns back toward the viewer. Her head tilts gently to one side beneath the wide, layered brim. Dark curls frame a pale face with a quiet, slightly distant gaze. A ribbon or soft scarf descends from the bonnet and wraps near her chin and neck. She wears a dark, long-sleeved dress with a fitted upper body, its fabric catching muted highlights along the shoulder and forearm. Her nearer arm bends and rests on the stone at the left, bringing the pose into a compact diagonal. The ledge fills the lower left foreground, with a grainy light top and coarse dark front edge. Behind her right elbow, another block of stone and shadow closes the lower background. The darkest value sits under the brim and in the clothing folds, making the face stand out through brightness rather than sharp outlines. Light seems to come from the upper left and front, grazing the cheek and the rough stone while leaving the underside of the hat in shade. Focus is strongest on the face and near clothing, then falls away into softly mottled surroundings. The print surface has visible grain, subdued highlights, and uneven brown-black tones that feel aged rather than digitally clean. The image contains no readable lettering. The overall composition is intimate and contemplative, using a turned face, deep fabric shadow, and pale weathered stone to create a restrained romantic stillness.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形棕褐色调摄影肖像呈现一名坐着的女子，戴宽大布帽，一只手臂倚在粗糙石沿上。背景是柔焦的户外深色植物、石材以及右上方一处小浅亮空隙。女子占据画面大部分，身体朝右，脸却回转看向观者。头在宽阔、层叠的帽檐下轻轻侧倾。深色卷发围着一张浅色脸，目光安静而略显疏远。一条缎带或柔软围巾从帽上垂下，绕在下巴与颈部附近。她穿深色长袖连衣裙，上身合体，布料在肩和前臂上接住暗淡高光。近侧手臂弯曲并搭在左边石面上，使姿势构成紧凑斜线。石沿占据左下前景，浅亮顶面带颗粒，正面边缘粗砺而暗。右肘后方，另一块石头和阴影封住下部背景。最深明度落在帽檐下与衣褶里，让脸靠亮度而非锐利轮廓突出。光似乎从左上和前方照来，掠过面颊与粗糙石面，让帽下保持阴影。焦点在脸与近处衣服上最清楚，随后落入柔和斑驳的周围环境。相纸表面可见颗粒、克制高光和不均匀的棕黑调子，显得陈旧而不是数字式干净。画面没有可读字样。整体构图亲近而沉思，以回转面孔、厚重布影和浅色风化石材营造克制的浪漫静止感。
style_prompt_en: The sepia photographic style uses soft focus and a narrow range of warm brown, cream, and deep black to make light feel absorbed by the print. A bright, gently modeled area sits against dense fabric-like shadow, so tonal contrast guides attention without hard modern sharpness. Layered dark shapes create a compact diagonal arrangement while pale rough texture provides a visual base. Edges become softer away from the focal plane, and background detail dissolves into irregular mottled marks. The surface retains visible grain, faint wear, and subdued highlights rather than smooth tonal perfection. Light arrives from one upper side, catching exposed planes and leaving recesses profoundly dark. The overall effect is intimate and timeworn, joining tactile print texture, graceful tonal falloff, and a quiet balance of softness and depth.
style_prompt_zh: 这种棕褐色调摄影以柔焦和暖棕、奶油白、深黑的狭窄色域，使光仿佛被相纸吸收。一块温和塑形的亮区抵着浓密如织物的阴影，调性对比无需现代式锐利边缘就能引导注意。层叠深形组成紧凑的斜向安排，浅亮粗糙肌理提供视觉基底。远离焦平面后，边缘逐渐柔化，背景细节溶解成不规则斑驳痕迹。表面保留可见颗粒、轻微磨损和受抑制的高光，而非平滑完美的调子。光从一侧上方进入，掠过外露平面，使凹处保持深暗。整体效果亲密且带着岁月痕迹，结合可触的相纸肌理、优雅的调子衰减与柔和和纵深之间安静的均衡。
theme_en: A seated woman in a broad bonnet leaning on a stone ledge
theme_zh: 一名戴宽大软帽的女子倚着石沿坐下
name: David Octavius Hill
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
